name: 2015-16 Guidance Counselor Reporting - Social Worker Data
description:
This dataset reports social worker staffing for New York City public schools during the 2015-16 school year, as part of the city's guidance counselor and social worker reporting. Each row represents one school, identified by its District Borough Number (dbn) and location name, along with its school type (elementary, high school, junior high/intermediate/middle, K-8, secondary, and others).

The remaining columns describe social worker staffing at each school: total social workers and guidance counselors combined (total_sw_gc), total social workers (total_sw), and breakdowns by full-time, part-time, bilingual, staff serving more than one location, and ATR (absent teacher reserve) status. Many fields use "No Data" where schools did not report a value, and staffing figures are sometimes fractional, reflecting shared or partial positions.
